source_text: 向前走4米，左转45度，然后停止。
construction: Fresh unchanged LiveMissionSession initialization per arm; no state teleport, origin transform or post-init reset. Transition uses existing Turn45 incl0.5s settle; force uses existing DisturbanceProxy from Walkstart+1.0 to+1.2. No change to physics timestep/default friction/model or controller. Complete paired parent/halt raw trace equality required; seen anchor also matches M2.3b. Actual body/joint/controller state difference must be demonstrated. Duplicate states not replaced/count as new independent conditions. Seed0 is bookkeeping, not random independence.

halt_acceptance.standing_basis: Existing RobotState standing/fallen computation: base height >=0.55m and tilt <=30deg; no new evaluator or controller threshold.

state_assessment.scope: Eligibility for this exact new local task at this observed simulation instant; no dwell, generic safe/recovered, or hardware stopping claim.

contracts.parent_open_loop: Explicit HIGH-risk TEST_ONLY override, no expansion of grounder capabilities
contracts.authority: Registered simulated TEST_ONLY principal and exact full-plan host permission, trusted serial only

stale_state_control: Last in refusal arm: issue while eligible, one G1Simulation.step with unchanged current ctrl/no policy evaluation, refresh current_state/increment all counters. Dispatch old grant then replay. Deliberate one physics step recorded separately; each refusal adds zero executor/node/physics/reset. No further new task or halt.
ineligible_controls: No prepare or issuance; ESCALATE / NOT_ISSUED with actual reasons, uncovered control denominator. Never count this as successful authorization rejection.
primary_endpoints: strict parent outcome and halt trigger presence

outcome_contract.no_trigger: NO_HALT_TRIGGER; retain parent PASS or skill/physical failure; no forced Stop
outcome_contract.missing_evidence: ESCALATE with unavailable fields, not halt or authorization success
outcome_contract.task_failure_after_valid_dispatch: Reliability negative; not auth failure; original staysFAILED
outcome_contract.all_stages_success: Only bounded two-new-condition support, no generalized reliability/statistical rate
outcome_contract.auth_leak_or_plan_mismatch: Integration failure and immediate campaign abort

stop_rules: Current task stops after design/independent review/Git: zero physics
Future integrity/reset/source/observer/plan/provenance failure aborts entire campaign, saving partial
Future ordinary science failures retain remaining predeclared arms; no repair/scan/retry
Unsafe/ineligible arm closes without dispatch; simulator close is not physical safety
Hard budget/stall saves PARTIAL_STOPPED without duplicate launch
Complete matrix ends campaign regardless outcome
required_before_future_acquisition: Future experiment-only adapter (not old acquire.py unchanged) with conditional missing-trigger/haltfailure/control coverage
Committed runner/source/official policy-model-asset hash manifest and watchdog before first step
Independent no-physics preflight and observer/command/reset contract review
Fresh reference equality validates observer noninterference; preserve every negative cell
normal_control_contract: Existing success mission executes normally with strict feedback/opt-in halt configuration. No lifecycle/grant/new Mission requested. Expected3/3 and no halt; report regression honestly, no recovery. Normal SUCCESS is not ESCALATE.
post_new_task_failure: Existing opt-in Runtime may request its original independent Stop on a new task strict Walk failure. Record child failure/halt separately; never promote new task toSUCCESS or overwrite parent. This is inherited behavior, not an added recovery. No extra/manual halt outside existing Runtime.
implementation_review_timing: Fixed push scheduled using native first-Walk entry simulation_time, exact>=start+1.0 and<start+1.2; must record start/end and xfrc_applied zero. Preserve seed/thread/runtime package versions from accepted acquisition; no RNG sampling. No state injection.
